title: The Open *Account*
dek: Anthropic's S-1 is public. New York opens frontier AI registration. Three accountability mechanisms converge in 30 days.

stories.label: Anthropic H1 2026 revenue, up from $1.16B a year earlier
stories.headline: Public markets will price AI without the cover of private valuation rounds.

stories.label: OpenAI's revised fundraising target, down from $30 billion
stories.headline: OpenAI revised its ask before Anthropic's IPO sets a public benchmark.
Scientific AI is being governed by vendor access policies, not institutions.

stories.label: required safety incident reporting window, NY RAISE Act, from January 2027
stories.headline: The first US state frontier AI registration regime is live this month.

stories.label: Saudi Aramco's payment for 49% stake in national AI firm HUMAIN
stories.headline: Gulf sovereign capital is formalizing AI as national infrastructure.
A third mandatory AI incident reporting regime is now in draft.

stories.label: time Meta and Fourier took to build the Max humanoid prototype
stories.headline: Humanoid robot development has compressed to a rapid-prototyping timeline.

stories.label: hours of robot movement data used to train Robbyant's embodied AI models
stories.headline: China is betting on physical training data volume over language-model fine-tuning.
The S-1 is filed; the roadshow questions will be harder to frame.
xAI's text watermarking tests whether EU AI Act compliance actually converges.

still_signal: Today's commitments, financial, regulatory, strategic, technical, share one property: none reads against the others. Accountability is arriving faster on the build side than on the governance side.
